summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry ("\x1b]0;{title}\x07") and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal, placed before set_alt_screen; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) for SET_WINDOW_TITLE codes; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading under Unreleased with a bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (returns early on legacy Windows), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests, black, and mypy are unverified. Nothing was committed.
